prompts.title: Sixty seconds of eye contact
prompts.body: Sit facing each other, put phones down, and hold steady eye contact for one minute. No talking. Notice what comes up.

prompts.title: Three things you noticed today
prompts.body: Tell each other three small things you noticed about the other person this week. Specific beats sweeping.

prompts.title: Compliment, then mirror
prompts.body: Give your partner one compliment. They repeat it back in their own words, then give one back. Take turns three rounds.

prompts.title: Ask one curious question
prompts.body: Ask something you've been quietly wondering about your partner but haven't asked. Listen all the way through before responding.

prompts.title: A twenty-second hug
prompts.body: Hug for a full twenty seconds, ideally longer. Notice what shifts when neither of you lets go first.

prompts.title: Your favorite shared memory
prompts.body: Each of you describes a favorite memory of the two of you together. Don't compare or rank — just listen.

prompts.title: Share a small fear
prompts.body: Share a small fear you've been carrying lately. The other person doesn't fix it — they just receive it.

prompts.title: High, low, buffalo
prompts.body: Each share your high of the week, your low, and one weird/funny/random thing (the 'buffalo'). No commentary until both are done.

prompts.title: Plan a tiny adventure
prompts.body: Together, plan a small adventure for this week — under two hours, under twenty dollars. Decide where and when before the conversation ends.

prompts.title: Cook one thing together
prompts.body: Pick a simple recipe neither of you has made and cook it together this week. The point is the doing, not the eating.

prompts.title: Pick five songs for them
prompts.body: Each make a five-song playlist that reminds you of the other. Listen to both back to back, holding hands.

prompts.title: Write a short letter from your future self
prompts.body: Write a two-paragraph letter from a version of yourself five years from now, addressed to the two of you today. Read them aloud to each other.

prompts.title: One device-free meal
prompts.body: Share one meal this week with phones in another room. Aim for sixty minutes. Notice the silences as much as the talking.

prompts.title: Five minutes back to back
prompts.body: Sit on the floor back to back, close enough to feel each other breathe. Five minutes of synchronized breathing, no talking.

prompts.title: A morning text with warmth
prompts.body: Send your partner a text first thing tomorrow morning saying one specific thing you're grateful for about them.

prompts.title: Their favorite tiny thing
prompts.body: Tell your partner the tiniest thing they do that you love. Wait for them to do it without prompting, then thank them.

prompts.title: Draw each other in two minutes
prompts.body: No looking at the paper, no lifting the pen. Two minutes each. Compare, laugh, keep the drawings somewhere.

prompts.title: First impression, revisited
prompts.body: Tell each other your honest first impression of the other, and how it has changed. Be generous with both versions.

prompts.title: A thirty-minute walk, no phones
prompts.body: Walk somewhere for thirty minutes, phones in pockets. No agenda. Let the conversation wander or not.

prompts.title: Thank you for doing the thing
prompts.body: Pick one chore your partner does that you don't always thank them for. Thank them today, specifically, by name of the task.

prompts.title: A fifteen-second kiss
prompts.body: A real fifteen-second kiss — count it. Notice what changes around second eight.

prompts.title: Show a secret talent
prompts.body: Each show your partner a small skill or party trick they haven't seen. No skill too small.

prompts.title: Find your favorite photo of us
prompts.body: Each scroll back and pick your favorite photo of the two of you. Share why. Make it a Live Photo if you have one.

prompts.title: Make one request without blame
prompts.body: Ask your partner for one thing you'd like more of, framed as a positive request. No mention of what they're not doing.

prompts.title: I noticed, I felt
prompts.body: Take turns: 'I noticed ____, and I felt ____.' Stay in observation + feeling, not story. Three rounds each.

prompts.title: Favorite thing about today
prompts.body: Trade favorite small things about today. Not the highlight reel — the moment between moments.

prompts.title: Dance to one song
prompts.body: Pick a song. Dance to it in the kitchen, the living room, wherever. No phones, no audience. One song, all the way through.

prompts.title: Imagine being old together
prompts.body: Each describe one small detail of the life you imagine sharing decades from now. Don't argue the details; collect them.

prompts.title: Trade a five-minute massage
prompts.body: Trade five-minute shoulder or hand massages. Time it. The receiver only says what feels good and what doesn't.

prompts.title: What I trust about you
prompts.body: Tell your partner one specific thing you trust about them. Wait for them to do the same. Don't reciprocate immediately — let the first sit.
